# Session 94 Plan — Wave 1: §VII.BA composite-bridge + α_s transport + A_s normalization (spectral-action moments)

**Date**: 2026-05-25
**Author**: connes-ncg-theorist (generated by /rclab-plan per-wave swarm)
**Owner agent**: connes-ncg-theorist (planner AND default executor; A_s gate routes to lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist)

## Wave 1 Summary

Wave 1 closes the §VII.BA composite-bridge-map dimensional-class program along the spectral-action / Connes-Karoubi axis, picking up the five carry-forwards surfaced by S93 W1 (§VII.BA composite-bridge) and S93 W7 (α_s transport + K_csub_R). The substrate IS the finite spectral triple `(A_K = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M_3(ℂ), H_K, D_K(τ_fold))`; `Res_W` is the unique trace on the pseudodifferential ideal `Ψ(A_K)` and `ρ_FULL(s) = M_FULL(s)/M_BARE(s)` is a substrate-IS cohomology-class ratio. Five gates: (1) advance the registered §VII.BA `#### (h)` STAGE-1-CANDIDATE joint two-axis theorem to STAGE-3-PERMANENT via a two-agent cross-axis independent-verify (JOINT clause (c) PASS-AND); (2) extend the T4|s≠s' `Res_W(s)/Res_W(s')` envelope beyond the L_max=12 cache ceiling via Friedrich-Bär analytic tail to test whether L3<L2 saturates (W1-3 found L3=2.065e1 > L2=2.055e1, not yet saturated); (3) land the T5 K_0-pairing Element-3 α_s direct-Connes-Karoubi recovery at the a_4 channel (s=2), a NEW cross-pillar bridge requiring the full 5-anatomy + Stage-2 PASS-AND; (4) prove UV-convergence of the FULL K_csub_R intercept via the substrate-canonical S61/S78 Pauli-Villars subtraction at Λ_UV=M_KK on the FULL a_2 Mellin-s=2 moment, with a 5-regulator FI check; (5) resolve the disclosed A_s 0.12-OOM normalization gap between M_Pl_spectral (a_2 second moment) and M_Pl_physical.

## Wave 1 Decision Point Prerequisites

All five gates consume ONLY S93/session-x verdicts and on-disk data files that are already landed — there are no within-S94 upstream prerequisites for Wave 1. Specifically:

- **§W1-1 (S94-VII-BA-STAGE-2-CROSS-AXIS-VERIFY)** consumes the registered §VII.BA `#### (h)` STAGE-1-CANDIDATE entry in `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` plus the three S93 W1 verdicts (W1-2 registration `d884675c…`, W1-1 `2a25113b…`, W1-3 T5 canonical `8b6ba6bc…`). All landed. If the registry slot is absent at dispatch (registry drift), the gate honestly closes PRE-REG-INC per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` §"When mechanical closure IS acceptable" item 1 (blocked_by §VII.BA `#### (h)` ABSENT).
- **§W1-2 (S94-VII-BA-T4-ENVELOPE-EXTENSION)** consumes the S93 W1-3 npz (`s93_w1_3_vii_ba_f_functor_non_scalar_reconstruction.npz`) + the L_max=12 master spectrum cache (`s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz`). Both landed.
- **§W1-3 (S94-VII-Bx-T5-ALPHA-S-A4-RECOVERY)** consumes the S93 W7-1 transport-degree result (`c34e4f17…`, deg=+2 NON-SCALAR), the W1-3 T5 machine-zero certificate (`8b6ba6bc…`), and `alpha_s_substrate_distance_1 = −0.08587279`. All landed. NOTE: this gate is itself a NEW STAGE-1-CANDIDATE landing; its Stage-2 PASS-AND is INTERNAL to the gate (the new-bridge derivation + a two-axis cross-verify in one dispatch), distinct from §W1-1's Stage-2 on the already-registered §VII.BA `#### (h)`.
- **§W1-4 (S94-K-CSUB-R-ABSOLUTE-CONVERGENCE)** consumes the S93 W7-2 FULL evaluator (`s93_w7_2_k_csub_r_full_physical_retry.py`, CLASS=FULL, `5ad9875b…`), `_cm_1995_residue_formula.py` (CLASS=FULL), `_pauli_villars_subtraction.py` (CLASS=SCHEMATIC — cross-check only), and `kappa_2_substrate_FW`. All landed.
- **§W1-5 (S94-A_S-MPL-CONVERGENCE)** consumes the a_2 second spectral moment (M_Pl_spectral) and `M_Pl_reduced`/`M_Pl_unreduced` (M_Pl_physical). All landed. The session-x W1 §P-11 disclosure is the source of the 0.12-OOM target.

No Wave 1 gate gates any other Wave 1 gate. The five run fully in parallel.

```yaml
# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Both axis-distinct reviewers independently PASS their single-axis clauses AND JOINT
  clause (c) PASS-ANDs across both verdicts AND substrate-input-orthogonality holds at
  ≥1 observable. Solution-space: the §VII.BA composite-bridge-map joint two-axis
  admissibility theorem becomes STAGE-3-PERMANENT — the FOURTH framework cross-axis
  joint theorem to reach permanence (after §VII.AH STAGE-3, the §VII.AH/§VII.AX
  precedents), eligible for citation as a structural theorem without the candidate
  qualifier. The composite-bridge dimensional-class wall (T1/T2/T4|s=s' FORBIDDEN;
  T3/T4|s≠s'/T5 ADMISSIBLE) is permanently established for all Mellin-cone bridges at s>0.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one reviewer returns FAIL on at least one clause (single-axis OR JOINT).
  Solution-space: Stage-2 → 3 promotion blocked; the theorem stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE;
  the FAILing clause(s) route to next-session remediation. A FAIL on a single-axis
  clause localizes the defect to that axis; a FAIL on the JOINT clause (c) means the
  Δ_scheme→0 operational test does not reproduce across the two independent re-derivations
  — the admissibility certificate is not structurally independent.
INFO_meaning: >
  At least one reviewer returns INFO on a clause (and no FAIL). Solution-space: theorem
  stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the INFO clause is documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item
  for next-session re-verify. Also fires if substrate-input-orthogonality cannot be
  established at ≥1 observable (both reviewers load the same data) — Stage-2 PASS-AND
  then establishes structural-OUTPUT-type independence but not structural-INPUT
  independence, and the verdict carries the substrate-input-overlap caveat (Verdict B
  per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Substrate-input-orthogonality clause"`).

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/session-94/s94_w1_1_vii_ba_stage_2_cross_axis_verify.py"
    - "computations/session-94/s94_w1_1_vii_ba_stage_2_cross_axis_verify.npz"
    - "computations/session-94/s94_w1_1_vii_ba_stage_2_cross_axis_verify.png"
  estimated_time: "0.5 wave-equivalents (~3-4 hours incl. two parallel cross-reviewer dispatches)"

substrate_framing: |
  The substrate IS the finite spectral triple (A_K = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M_3(ℂ), H_K, D_K) at
  τ_fold. The §VII.BA composite bridge map B = f⊙g is a structural property of the
  substrate's OWN Wodzicki/HKR/K_0 morphisms — `Res_W` is the unique trace on Ψ(A_K)
  (a substrate-intrinsic functional), the HKR factor is the orientability-axiom Chern
  character, and the K_0-pairing carries the substrate's own χ-image BdG inheritance
  class. The two-axis admissibility (homogeneity degree deg(B)=d_A ∧ substrate-natural
  non-scalar binding) is NOT a transformation between containers; it is the substrate's
  algebraic-trace dimensional structure dictating what its bridge maps CAN be. Stage-2
  cross-verify confirms this structural property is independently re-derivable from the
  registered entry alone (no workshop context), so the "agreement" between the two

  pathway — it breaks the shared-context-produces-shared-output failure mode that the
  generic "agreement among agents" exclusion (`epistemic-discipline.md`) forbids.
```

## §W1-2. S94-VII-BA-T4-ENVELOPE-EXTENSION

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S94-VII-BA-T4-ENVELOPE-EXTENSION"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"                            # tests the DIRECTION of L3 vs L2 as L_max grows (does L3 cross below L2?)
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "connes-ncg-theorist"
hypothesis: "The T4|s≠s' `Res_W(s)/Res_W(s')` differential-SUM-growth envelope, extended beyond the L_max=12 cache ceiling via the Friedrich-Bär analytic tail over L∈[14,100], either saturates so that the Level-3 anchor drops below the Level-2 envelope (L3 < L2 ⇒ T4|s≠s' admissible as an ALTERNATIVE Element-3) OR persists L3 > L2 (T4|s≠s' not envelope-saturated ⇒ T5 remains the SOLE admissible Element-3)."

method:
  description: >
    Extend the T4|s≠s' envelope test of S93 W1-3 (which found, at the L_max=12 cache
    ceiling, Level-3 anchor L3 = 2.065e1 > Level-2 envelope L2 = 2.055e1 — the deg-+2(s'−s)
    differential-SUM-growth of Res_W(s)/Res_W(s') not yet saturated). Compute Res_W(s) and
    Res_W(s') (the Wodzicki residues of D_K^{−2s} at distinct poles s∈{2,3}) on the
    Friedrich-Bär analytic tail for L∈[14,100] — NO raw diagonalization above L=12 per
    `math-scripts.md §"D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility
    Pre-Check"`. The Friedrich-Bär saturation theorem (S87 W11-2/W11-3 precedent) bounds
    new-sector eigenvalue contributions via η_FB(p,q) = |λ|_min(p,q)/√(C_2(p,q)+1) on the
    L_max=12 master cache; the analytic tail extends Res_W(s,L) per the Casimir-bound
    contribution of each NEW (p,q) sector at p+q ∈ [13, 100]. Re-fit the Level-2 envelope
    exponent and the Level-3 anchor at the asymptotic window and test L3 < L2.
  producing_script: "computations/session-94/s94_w1_2_vii_ba_t4_envelope_extension.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "L3(L_max) < L2(L_max) at L_max ∈ {14, ..., 100}  [Level-3 anchor strictly below Level-2 envelope ⇒ T4|s≠s' admissible]"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "L3_asymptotic < L2_asymptotic at the Friedrich-Bär saturation window L_fit ∈ [50, 100]"
  direction: "<"

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §'Registry-PASS criterion' (Level-3 < Level-2 at canonical L_max); §'Level-2 empirical-β verification rule' (asymptotic via Friedrich-Bär saturation L∈[10,100]); math-scripts.md §'D_K Block-Diagonality + Recursive-Casimir-Projection Feasibility Pre-Check' (η_FB lower-bound)"

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "L_max integer mesh over [14, 100] (87 points); the per-sector Casimir-bound contribution at each integer p+q is a Fraction-arithmetic Sage-Q evaluation"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "87 L_max values over [14, 100]"
  L_max: "14..100 (Friedrich-Bär analytic tail; NO raw diagonalization above L=12 — operative L_max for the cache anchor is 12)"
  scan_range: "[14, 100] L_max integer mesh; pole pair (s, s') = (2, 3) per W7-1 a_4/a_2 ratio"
  step_size: "1 (integer L_max step)"
  tolerance: "|L3_asymptotic − L2_asymptotic| evaluated at L_fit=[50,100]; PASS iff L3 < L2 with margin > 1e-3 in M_KK²-normalized units; if |asymptotic − empirical(L=12)|/asymptotic > 0.10, cite the cache-ceiling effect + Friedrich-Bär saturation theorem per `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §'Level-2 empirical-β verification rule'`"
  scheme: "T4-Res_W-ratio-Friedrich-Bar-analytic-tail"
  convention: "VII-BA-T4-s-neq-s-prime-Res_W-over-Res_W-deg-2-differential-SUM-growth"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic Casimir-bound analytic tail"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (the analytic tail is a per-sector Fraction-arithmetic sum, not a diagonalization; the L=12 cache anchor is read from the master npz)"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap", "w1_3_npz_sha", "L12_cache_sha"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "T4|s≠s' = Res_W(s)/Res_W(s') has Level-3 anchor decreasing toward the
            Level-2 envelope as L_max grows; the gate tests whether L3 crosses BELOW L2."
    Step 1: Res_W(s, L_max) = Wodzicki residue of D_K^{−2s} truncated at L_max.
            [corpus §18.1 — Res_W(L=8/10/12)={4.346e4, 9.340e4, 1.750e5} ~ L^3.4 SUM-growth
             at s=3; deg(Res_W) = −2s ≠ 0 (Wodzicki uniqueness, Connes 1994 §2.3)]
    Step 2: T4 = Res_W(s)/Res_W(s'), s≠s'.  deg(T4) = deg(Res_W(s)) − deg(Res_W(s'))
            = (−2s) − (−2s') = 2(s'−s).
            [corpus §18.0 taxonomy row T4: deg = 2(s'−s); s=2,s'=3 ⇒ deg = +2]
    Step 3: At L_max=12 (cache ceiling), W1-3 measured L3 = 2.065e1, L2 = 2.055e1
            ⇒ L3 − L2 = +0.10 > 0 (Level-3 ABOVE Level-2; deg-+2 differential SUM-growth
             not yet saturated). [S93 W1-3 carry-forward CF-S94-W1-B]
    Step 4: Substitute the Friedrich-Bär analytic tail. For L_max > 12, NEW-sector
            eigenvalues are bounded below by η_FB_lower · √(C_2(p+q=L_max)+1). The
            differential SUM Res_W(s) − Res_W(s') saturates iff the NEW-sector
            contributions to numerator and denominator equalize in the deg-2 ratio.
            Define ΔL(L_max) = L3(L_max) − L2(L_max). Then:
              ΔL(12) = +0.10 (measured).
              sign(dΔL/dL_max) determines saturation direction.
    Step 5: Direction read-off.
              If ΔL(L_max) → negative as L_max → ∞ (L_fit=[50,100]): L3 < L2 ⇒ PASS
                ⇒ T4|s≠s' is an ADMISSIBLE alternative Element-3 (T5 not unique).
              If ΔL(L_max) stays ≥ 0 through L_max=100: L3 ≥ L2 ⇒ FAIL the L3<L2 test
                ⇒ T4|s≠s' is structurally-admissible (deg-match + non-scalar) but NOT
                envelope-saturated ⇒ T5 remains the SOLE registry-PASS-eligible Element-3.
    Conclusion: the SIGN of ΔL_asymptotic is the verdict metric. This is a [SIGN] gate;
                the 3-tuple companion row carries sign_verdict (does L3 cross below L2),
                magnitude_verdict (|ΔL_asymptotic| vs the 1e-3 band), regime_verdict
                (is the Friedrich-Bär saturation window genuinely reached, f_used vs the
                95%/50% bands — the analytic tail is defined unconditionally on [14,100]
                so regime=VALID by construction unless the η_FB bound fails to converge).

    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  w1_3_npz:
    path: "computations/session-93/s93_w1_3_vii_ba_f_functor_non_scalar_reconstruction.npz"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  L12_master_cache:

# ---- Output artifacts ----
output_artifacts:
  script:
    path: "computations/session-94/s94_w1_2_vii_ba_t4_envelope_extension.py"
    artifact_kind: "script"
    must_contain:
      - "from canonical_constants import"
```

```yaml
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The PV-subtracted a_2 Mellin-s=2 moment is UV-convergent, so its K_csub_R
            intercept converges to a finite L_max→∞ limit (|ΔK/ΔL|→0), unlike the bare
            FULL moment which grows with L_max (intercept +247260)."
    Step 1: a_2^{bare}(s=2, L_max) = Σ_{(p,q), p+q≤L_max} d(p,q) · |λ(p,q,τ_fold)|^{−4}
            (s=2 ⇒ −2s=−4). [the FULL a_2 Mellin moment; W7-2 FULL_intercept=+247259.9583]

            intercept is large because the moment is not UV-convergent at fixed τ).

            (M_KK,+2; √2·M_KK,−1)):
              a_2^{Pauli-Villars}(s=2) = Σ_k m_k [ λ_k^{−4}
                                                   − 2·(λ_k² + M_KK²)^{−2}
                                                   + 1·(λ_k² + 2·M_KK²)^{−2} ]
            [the regulator masses are at Λ_UV = M_KK; the multiplier weights {+2, −1} with
             masses {M_KK, √2·M_KK} satisfy the PV constraint Σ c_j = 1 and Σ c_j M_j² = 0
             so the leading and subleading UV divergences cancel]
    Step 3: Substitute. For large C_2(p,q) (high sectors), the bracket
              λ^{−4} − 2(λ²+M_KK²)^{−2} + (λ²+2M_KK²)^{−2}
            ~ O(M_KK^4 · λ^{−8}) as λ → ∞ (the PV subtraction raises the UV power by 4),
            so a_2^{Pauli-Villars} CONVERGES: the high-sector tail sum Σ d(p,q) λ^{−8}
            converges (d(p,q) ~ (p+q)² polynomial vs λ^{−8} ~ exp(−8τρ)·C_2^{−4}).
    Step 4: K_csub_R^{PV}(L_max) = polyfit-intercept of M_Pl_eff_sq^{PV}(L_max) vs inv_L =
            1/L_max over L∈[10, cutoff]. Because a_2^{Pauli-Villars} converges, the per-L_max
            moment plateaus ⇒ dK_csub_R^{PV}/d(1/L_max) → finite ⇒ |ΔK/ΔL_max| → 0.
            Direction: |ΔK/ΔL| DECREASES toward 0 as L_max grows (convergence), vs the bare
            moment where |ΔK/ΔL| stays O(intercept-scale) (divergence).
    Step 5: FI check. K_csub_R^{Mellin} = K_csub_R^{ζ} EXACTLY (F2FI=True at W7-2, by
            zeta-Mellin equivalence on the positive-definite spectrum). Extend: the PV-
            subtracted intercept across {Pauli-Villars, Mellin, ζ} (FULL) agrees; the
            SCHEMATIC {heat-kernel, hard-cutoff} cross-check is within the O(20%) heat-kernel-
            moment-ratio band (regulator-class FI, NOT exact for the SCHEMATIC pair).
    Conclusion: PASS iff |ΔK/ΔL|→0 (UV-convergent PV-subtracted intercept) AND the 5-regulator
                FI spread is within band. The convergent K_csub_R becomes a canonical pin
                (promoted_from = S94-K-CSUB-R-ABSOLUTE-CONVERGENCE; Source-Recon class-(e)).
```

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (§VII.AU winding / 3He-B BDI Level-3 / α=−3 Layer-1) does NOT consume any Wave 1 output — the two waves are independent (Wave 2's inputs are the S93 W2 §VII.AU carry-forwards). No cross-wave branching from Wave 1 into Wave 2.

Downstream consequences of Wave 1 verdicts (for session-end synthesis + the next-session planner, NOT a Wave-2 prerequisite):

- **§W1-1 PASS** → §VII.BA `#### (h)` advances to STAGE-3-PERMANENT; the orchestrator updates the registry tag (STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT) at session-end synthesis per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 3"`. This is the FOURTH framework cross-axis joint theorem to reach permanence and a K-counter advancement instance for the substrate-input-orthogonality clause (already K=3 MANDATORY).
- **§W1-1 FAIL/INFO** → §VII.BA stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing/INFO clause routes to the S95 plan as a Stage-2 re-verify carry-forward.
- **§W1-2 PASS** (L3<L2 saturates) → the §VII.BA admissible Element-3 set widens to {T3, T4|s≠s', T5}; the registry §VII.BA entry adds T4|s≠s' as a co-admissible route. **§W1-2 FAIL** (L3≥L2 persists) → T5 confirmed SOLE admissible Element-3; the registry text is SHARPENED accordingly.
- **§W1-3 PASS** → a NEW §VII STAGE-1-CANDIDATE slot lands for the α_s transport bridge; the orchestrator allocates the next-free-letter §VII slot via the registry-write helper (mack-cosmic-bridge sole writer) and appends the gate-ID to the methodology-wave-allowlist ONLY if the landing is METHODOLOGY-class (it is COMPUTE-class — a new-bridge derivation — so NO allowlist append). Its Stage-2 PASS-AND is internal; a PASS means the new bridge is STAGE-1-CANDIDATE with Stage-2 already cleared, so S95 carries a Stage-3 promotion CF. **§W1-3 FAIL** → the α_s home-pole bridge remains open; route to S95 with an alternative-formulation (T3/T4) carry-forward.
- **§W1-4 PASS** → the convergent K_csub_R is promoted to a canonical pin (`update_constant("K_csub_R_FW", value, session="S94", source="S94-K-CSUB-R-ABSOLUTE-CONVERGENCE", ...)` per the canonical write-order: verdict → canonical_constants.py → falsifier-inventory). **§W1-4 FAIL** → the 2-point-PV-at-Λ_UV=M_KK corridor closes; S95 carries a higher-point-PV or alternative-regulator carry-forward.
- **§W1-5 PASS/INFO/FAIL** → updates the A_s normalization status; a FAIL re-opens the a_2↔Newton-coupling normalization for S95.
